'''Gaartatha''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who worked as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His [[Gaartatha's companion|partner]] was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], a fate that the Wookiee barely escaped himself. Gaartatha dealt with this loss by finding solace in [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], all the while hoping to find companions who could assist him in rescuing his partner. For a [[Time/Legends|time]], he joined up with fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Stannik Nhaa]].

==Biography==
Gaartatha was a hulking, shaggy, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. He worked as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]],<ref name="Handbook" /> freelance [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and shipper during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|305|Gaartatha}}</ref> alongside a [[Gaartatha's companion|close friend]]. The two companions had an altercation with an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|press gang]] that was hunting for slaves for a work colony. Gaartatha's partner was captured in the encounter, while Gaartatha only barely escaped himself. Affected by grief, Gaartatha turned to [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], while also looking for a lead and help to rescue his companion. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] of mourning, he visited a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and consumed several [[Dentarian Ripple]]s until he began to smell of the drink's odour. Also present in the cantina on that occasion was [[D'Voras Brin]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] extraordinare. While the Wookiee was waiting near the entrance of the cantina, [[Stannik Nhaa]], a young member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], entered, searching for Brin and hoping to find transportation offworld. Gaartatha allied with Nhaa and traveled with the Rebel for some time.<ref name="Handbook" />

==Personality and traits==
Gaartatha was deeply affected by the capture of his companion by Imperial slavers. While he hoped for a rescue, the Wookiee knew that he was incapable of saving his partner on his own. In his grief, Gaartatha consumed copious amounts of alcohol.<ref name="Handbook" /> Translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the prefix "Gaar" meant meant "brave/bold/fearless" and the suffix "tatha" meant "bite/biter/claw."<ref name="Callsigns">{{GamerCite|10|Callsigns: Names of Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Gaartatha worked as a scout, gaining [[Technician/Legends|mechanical]] proficiency alongside knowledge of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]]. He was a seasoned [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawler]], but was also capable with both a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]], the latter a traditional Wookiee weapon.<ref name="Handbook" />

==Equipment==
Gaartatha wore an armless vest that had numerous pockets.<ref name="Handbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gaartatha was first introduced in the [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', within a section written by [[Steven H. Lorenz]]. ''Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook'' was published in [[1993]] by [[West End Games]] for the second edition of [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]. Within the supplement, Gaartatha was illustrated by [[Mike Jackson]].<ref name="Handbook" />
